themes.summary: Hormuz transits fell to 19 on Nov. 2 versus October average of 25 amid ship attacks, while Hormuz flows recovered unevenly and STS transfers persisted.
Crude settled lower despite US strikes on Qeshm Island as the market took the softer diplomacy path and signs Middle East conflict could ease were noted.
Ukraine resumed refinery attacks, taking an estimated 47% of Russian refining offline, lifting diesel cracks, with Samara hub also hit.
Aramco CEO says global stocks need rebuilding and product stocks are alarmingly low, with distillate shortfall of about 1.5 million b/d per CERA.
Tanker indices are at record highs and weigh on export economics, though Atlantic rates softened Nov. 3 and fleet growth of 22.6% through 2029 is forecast.
